crossRefs.note: Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the household. (Now Obadiah feared Yahweh greatly;
Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect…
Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect: not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: He answered him, “It is I. Go, tell your lord, ‘Behold, Elijah is here!’ ”
translations.bsb: “It is I,” he answered. “Go tell your master, ‘Elijah is here!’”
translations.kjv: And he answered him, I am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
translations.asv: And he answered him, It is I: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
